text: Most companies will laugh you out of the room if you try to replace people with an unsupervised AI process. AI + Humans > AI alone. Every day of the week and twice on weekends. Here is what the agent does: • Looks into AI topics • Sends a summary of ideas to Slack • Waits for the user to approve those ideas • Writes the approved notes directly into Google Docs Without the approval gate, the agent will litter the document with garbage. It would go off in random directions, and people would spend more time fixing its output than it would've taken them to do the work themselves. With the gate, the user approves a direction, and the agent will execute it cleanly. This pattern works everywhere: • Sales reviews leads before they hit HubSpot • Finance signs off before invoices get processed • DevOps confirms before a deploy runs • Legal checks before a contract is filled Your agents don't need to be perfect.
